integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect your own accounts so BEE can act on your behalf — sequences sent via Gmail or LinkedIn go out from your real account, not a shared server one. Salesforce brings your CRM into BEE, read-only.

callbackErrors.denied: You cancelled the connection — nothing was connected.
callbackErrors.invalid_state: The connection link expired or is invalid. Try again.
callbackErrors.invalid_request: The provider didn't send the expected data. Try again.
callbackErrors.exchange_failed: The provider rejected the connection. Try again in a few minutes.

automation.hint: n8n, Zapier, Make, or your own system connect here — create an outbound webhook and point its "Webhook" node (or equivalent trigger) at the URL we give you. No shared credentials involved: every event arrives signed with X-BEE-Signature so you can verify it actually came from BEE.

biFeed.title: Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio…
biFeed.subtitle: Generate an API key and paste it into your BI tool's "Web" connector — three read-only, paginated feeds, ready to model as related tables (companies, leads, opportunities).
biFeed.noKeyYetHint: Generate an API key below to fill in ?org_key=… — without it, your BI tool won't know which organization to pull data from.

secretReveal.title: Save this key now — it won't be shown again.
secretReveal.help: Paste it into your BI tool's Web connector as an ?org_key= URL parameter, or as an X-BEE-Org-Key header if the tool supports one.

serverChannels.caption: Configured once for the whole BEE deployment, not per account — see the backend's environment variables if you need to change them.

inbound.title: Inbound signals (webhook)
inbound.subtitle: Anything that can POST — your CRM, Zapier/Make, your own script, a data provider — can push signals into BEE. Every signal is classified, scored against your ICP and, when it qualifies, becomes an opportunity with a strategy attached.
inbound.noKeyHint: Generate an API key (below, under Reporting & BI — it's the same key) to authenticate your requests. Without it, signals arrive unscoped and won't show up in your account.
inbound.keyReady: You already have {count, plural, one {# active API key} other {# active API keys}} — use any of them in the header.

teamProfiles.title: Team focus
teamProfiles.subtitle: Bias which signals surface first in Priority for each team, and steer account research toward what they actually sell.
teamProfiles.noWeights: No signal weighting yet — every signal type ranks neutrally.
teamProfiles.weightsHint: A weight above 1 makes that signal type surface higher in this team's Priority feed; below 1 pushes it down. 1 = neutral (default).
teamProfiles.researchFocusPlaceholder: E.g. Focus on regulatory readiness for LATAM fintech accounts.

autopilot.title: Autopilot guardrails
autopilot.subtitle: Let BEE send outbound actions on its own above a confidence threshold — everything else still waits in the queue for a human.
autopilot.warning: Turning this on lets BEE send outbound actions without a human clicking approve, whenever its confidence score clears the threshold below. Set it deliberately.
autopilot.thresholdHint: Only actions BEE scores at or above this confidence auto-send. Everything below it still lands in the approval queue.
autopilot.forbiddenHint: An action whose content contains any of these words never auto-sends, regardless of confidence.
autopilot.excludedHint: Company IDs BEE will never auto-execute against — one per line or comma-separated. These accounts always require manual approval.

simulation.hint: Backtest this config against real opportunity history before saving it — nothing is sent or persisted by running it.
simulation.autoWinRate: Win rate of what would have auto-approved: {pct}%.
simulation.noAutoOutcomeData: Not enough closed-outcome data yet for what would have auto-approved.
simulation.manualWinRate: Win rate of what stayed manual review: {pct}%.
simulation.noManualOutcomeData: Not enough closed-outcome data yet for what stayed manual review.
simulation.nearMiss: {count} protected accounts that would have otherwise qualified.
simulation.noHistory: No opportunities with a confidence score in this window yet.

federatedIntelligence.title: Federated signal intelligence
federatedIntelligence.subtitle: Share anonymized, aggregate-only stats from your own closed-deal history with other participating organizations, to calibrate your own signal confidence with their collective experience.
federatedIntelligence.explainer: Nothing raw is ever shared — no company names, no contacts, no signal content. Only aggregate statistics (signal type + industry → win rate), and only once several distinct organizations have contributed to the same bucket — never before.
federatedIntelligence.optedInToast: You're now participating in federated intelligence.
federatedIntelligence.optedOutToast: You've stopped participating in federated intelligence.
